Setup & Credentials

AI Routing (Managed)

LLM providers and API keys are managed by the platform for reliability, cost control, and automatic fallback.

  • Primary: DeepSeek handles default generation for best cost-performance.
  • Fallback 1: OpenAI handles overflow and provider-side throttling events.
  • Fallback 2: Claude is used as premium quality backstop.
  • Fallback 3: xAI is available as final fallback.
BYOK disabled Server-managed keys Automatic fallback routing

LinkedIn Access Token & Person ID

These are required for posting directly to LinkedIn from the platform.

  • Create a LinkedIn Developer app and configure OAuth redirect URI.
  • Complete OAuth authorization to obtain an access token.
  • Fetch profile data using LinkedIn API and copy your person URN (for example: urn:li:person:XXXX).
  • Save both values in Settings → LinkedIn Integration.
Power Tools
Style Clone
AI learns your unique writing voice from samples and applies it to every generated post.
  • Open the Style Clone tab from the sidebar.
  • Paste 2–15 of your best LinkedIn posts as writing samples.
  • Click Analyse & Clone My Voice to extract your writing DNA.
  • Review your voice fingerprint — tone, rhythm, openers, and signature phrases.
  • Enable the toggle — all future posts will match your style automatically.
AI-Powered Cloning
Repurpose
Turn any URL or pasted text into 3 LinkedIn-ready post variants with different angles.
  • Open the Repurpose tab from the sidebar.
  • Paste a blog URL or switch to text mode and paste content directly.
  • Select your industry and role for context-aware generation.
  • Click Extract & Generate 3 Posts — AI fetches, extracts key insights, and writes variants.
  • Copy any variant to the LinkedIn Post tab for further editing or schedule it directly.
3 Angles, One Source
Best Time to Post
Personalized posting windows based on your history and global LinkedIn engagement data.
  • Open the Best Time tab from the sidebar.
  • View day-of-week engagement scores color-coded by performance level.
  • Check optimal posting hours ranked by expected engagement.
  • Review your top personalised posting windows with confidence scores.
  • Click Schedule Next Post at Best Time to auto-fill the scheduler with your #1 slot.
Smart Analytics
Knowledge Base & Templates Workflow

How to use Knowledge Base

  • Go to Knowledge Base tab and upload PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV, or PPTX files.
  • After upload, files are indexed for retrieval during generation.
  • In LinkedIn Post tab, select KB mode (all files, selected files, or no KB).

How to train/retrain Knowledge Base

  • Click Rebuild KB from All Files to reprocess everything.
  • Use rebuild after large file updates or replacements.
  • Watch status indicators for indexing progress and chunk counts.

How to create templates

  • Open Custom Template section and click New Template.
  • Name the template and select the relevant files.
  • Click Save Template to persist file mapping.

How to use templates in post generation

  • In LinkedIn Post tab, expand Selected Files & Workspace Templates.
  • Choose a template and click Apply Template.
  • Generate post to use that template's selected files as context.
Platform Features

Core platform capabilities

  • Multi-provider AI support: Gemini, Anthropic, and OpenAI.
  • Knowledge-grounded generation with uploaded business documents.
  • Scheduling, queue management, and post history tracking.
  • Reusable presets and reusable KB templates for faster workflows.
  • Per-user settings and onboarding checklist to speed setup.

LinkedIn Post features

  • Simple and Advanced generation modes.
  • Audience, role, tone, goal, hashtag, emoji, and length controls.
  • Topic selection and optional preset application.
  • Generate, regenerate, schedule, or post-now in one flow.
  • Pre-publish insights with quality score, readability, and CTA checks.
  • Quick refinement tools: Shorten, Hook, CTA, Rephrase, Tags, and Variants.
Frequently Asked Questions
Why is post generation not using my uploaded files?

Check the LinkedIn Post tab and ensure Knowledge Base mode is set to either Use All Uploaded Files or Use Selected Files from Upload.

If you recently uploaded documents, run Rebuild KB from All Files and wait for indexing to finish.

Which template should I pick for a post?

Pick the template that best matches the exact subject of your post (for example, product updates, compliance, or market analysis).

Smaller, focused templates usually produce cleaner and more relevant output than very broad templates.

How do I verify AI and LinkedIn setup?

AI routing is managed automatically by the platform. In Settings, only confirm LinkedIn credentials and then generate a sample post.

If anything fails, re-check token expiry, person URN format, and network connectivity.

How does Style Clone affect my generated posts?

Once you provide writing samples and enable Style Clone, the AI analyses your sentence rhythm, vocabulary, tone, and signature phrases to build a voice fingerprint.

All future posts will be generated in your cloned style. You can disable the toggle in the Style Clone tab to return to default AI writing.

Can I repurpose content from any URL?

Yes — the Repurpose tab supports blog posts, articles, newsletters, and most publicly accessible web pages. You can also paste raw text.

The AI extracts key insights and creates three different LinkedIn post angles: a data-driven take, a personal perspective, and a contrarian view.

How accurate is Best Time to Post?

Best Time combines your personal post history engagement data with global LinkedIn engagement patterns to recommend optimal posting windows.

The more posts you publish and track, the more personalised and accurate the recommendations become. You can schedule directly from the best time slot.

What's the difference between the Quick Refinement tools?

Shorten trims your post for conciseness. Hook strengthens the opening line. CTA adds or improves the call-to-action. Rephrase rewrites with different wording. Tags refreshes hashtags. Variants generates alternative drafts.

All refinements preserve your original meaning and style (especially powerful when combined with Style Clone).
